Examples.Title: Get Render Status
Examples.Description: Get the rendering status, temporary asset url and details of a render by ID. **Base URL:** https://api.shotstack.io/edit/{version}
Examples.Code:
### Get Render Status
# @name getRender
GET {{host}}/edit/v1/render/{{id}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: The render status details
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Generate Asset
Examples.Description: Generate a single image, video or audio asset from a text prompt without rendering a full edit. Submit a prompt-bearing asset; the response is immediate when an identical asset has been generated before (results are cached by prompt, model and options), otherwise the job is queued and can be polled via the status endpoint. Generation is billed in credits per asset. Identical repeat requests resolve from the cache at no charge. **Base URL:** https://api.shotstack.io/edit/{version}
Examples.Code:
### Generate Asset
# @name postGenerate
POST {{host}}/edit/v1/generate
Idempotency-Key: {{Idempotency-Key}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "asset": {
    "type": "image",
    "prompt": "A lighthouse on a rocky coast at sunset, cinematic lighting",
    "model": "nano-banana-2"
  }
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: The asset was generated before: `done` with its URL, or `failed` with the error that ended it.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 202
# Description: The generation job has been queued. Poll the status endpoint.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: The request is invalid, for example a missing asset or prompt, a disallowed URL or a `length` that is not positive.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 402
# Description: The account has too few credits for this generation. `available` holds how many it has.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: The account cannot use this generation. `code` says why.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 409
# Description: The `Idempotency-Key` was already used for a different asset.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 429
# Description: The account has reached its generation quota.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 503
# Description: A service the request depends on is temporarily unavailable. `code` is `AiAccessUnavailable` when access to AI generation could not be confirmed.
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Quote Generation
Examples.Description: Estimate credits for the same asset and clip length accepted by `POST /generate`. Requires an API key and the same model access as generation. Invalid options and disallowed source URLs are rejected. No provider request, job, quota usage or credit reservation is created. A quote does not guarantee an available balance or quota. Prices are evaluated at request time. Request another quote when settings change; generation uses the current price when submitted. **Base URL:** https://api.shotstack.io/edit/{version}
Examples.Code:
### Quote Generation
# @name postGenerateQuote
POST {{host}}/edit/v1/generate/quote
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "asset": {
    "type": "image",
    "prompt": "A lighthouse on a rocky coast at sunset, cinematic lighting",
    "model": "nano-banana-2"
  }
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: The generation credit estimate.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: The request is invalid, for example a missing asset or prompt, a disallowed URL or a `length` that is not positive.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: An API key is required.
# 403
# Description: The account cannot use this generation. `code` says why.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 503
# Description: A service the request depends on is temporarily unavailable. `code` is `AiAccessUnavailable` when access to AI generation could not be confirmed.
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Render Asset
Examples.Description: Queue and render the contents of an [Edit](#tocs_edit) as a video, image or audio file. **Rendering Process:** 1. **Validation**: The edit JSON is validated 2. **Download**: All assets are downloaded and cached 3. **Preprocessing**: Video assets are automatically processed to fix compatibility issues 4. **Rendering**: The timeline is rendered using the processed assets 5. **Output**: The final media file is generated and stored **Video Preprocessing:** Video assets undergo automatic preprocessing to ensure compatibility. You can force preprocessing by setting `"transcode": true` on video assets. See [VideoAsset](#tocs_videoasset) for more details. **Base URL:** https://api.shotstack.io/edit/{version}

Examples.Title: Create Template
Examples.Description: Save an [Edit](#tocs_edit) as a re-usable template. Templates can be retrieved and modified in your application before being rendered. [Merge fields](#tocs_mergefield) can be also used to merge data in to a template and [render](#render-template) it in a single request. **Base URL:** https://api.shotstack.io/edit/{version}

Examples.Title: Render Template
Examples.Description: Render an asset from a template id and optional merge fields. Merge fields can be used to replace placeholder variables within the [Edit](#tocs_edit). **Base URL:** https://api.shotstack.io/edit/{version}
Examples.Code:
### Render Template
# @name postTemplateRender
POST {{host}}/edit/v1/templates/render
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "id": "f5493c17-d01f-445c-bb49-535fae65f219",
  "merge": [
    {
      "find": "NAME",
      "replace": "Jane"
    }
  ]
}

## Responses
# 201
# Description: The queued status including the render id. Check the status of the render using the id and the  [render status](#get-render-status) endpoint.
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Update Template
Examples.Description: Update an existing template by template id. **Base URL:** https://api.shotstack.io/edit/{version}

Examples.Title: Fetch Source
Examples.Description: Queue a source file to be fetched from a URL and stored by Shotstack. Source files can be videos, images, audio files and fonts. Once ingested, new [output renditions](#tocs_outputs) can be created from the source file. **Base URL:** https://api.shotstack.io/ingest/{version}
Examples.Code:
### Fetch Source
# @name postSource
POST {{host}}/ingest/v1/sources
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "url": "https://github.com/shotstack/test-media/raw/main/captioning/scott-ko.mp4"
}

## Responses
# 201
# Description: The queued source file details
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: A list of validation and other errors
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Transfer Asset
Examples.Description: Transfer a file from any publicly available URL to one or more Serve API [destinations](#tocs_destinations). **Base URL:** https://api.shotstack.io/serve/{version}
Examples.Code:
### Transfer Asset
# @name postServeAsset
POST {{host}}/serve/v1/assets
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "url": "https://s3-ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com/shotstack-assets/music/moment.mp3",
  "id": "018e8937-5015-75ee-aab6-03f214981133",
  "destinations": [
    {
      "provider": "shotstack"
    }
  ]
}

## Responses
# 200
# Description: The transfer request details and status
# Content-Type: application/json
